page_title: BOC 1-1 KOL | Bochum v FC Koln 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by FC Koln, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+3' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) makes a strong challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to Bernardo (Bochum) for a tough tackle.
89' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
88' Linton Maina will be replaced by Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln).
87' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
85' Bernardo (Bochum) makes a rough challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) will deliver the corner kick.
83' The ball possession is 50:50.
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) coming on for Philipp Hofmann.
81' Substitution. Lukas Daschner leaves the pitch and is replaced by Philipp Forster (Bochum).
81' Thomas Letsch has decided to make a change. Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) replaces Takuma Asano.
79' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) is able to continue to play.
78' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' The foul by Lukas Daschner (Bochum) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Matthias Jollenbeck.
76' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
74' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Luca Waldschmidt is replaced by Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln).
74' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rasmus Carstensen.
74' A corner kick by Bochum is thwarted by the well prepared Marvin Schwabe (1. FC Koln).
73' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
73' Bochum force their opponents to concede a corner.
73' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
69' Substitution. Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) has come on for Moritz-Broni Kwarteng.
69' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Marvin Schwabe has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
68' One of the FC Koln players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle. Bochum are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

66' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball bounced away off the left post!
65' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) commits a foul and Matthias Jollenbeck immediately signals a free kick.
63' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
61' FC Koln failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

61' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Manuel Riemann, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
58' Substitution. Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) in, Mark Uth out.
58' Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
56' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
54' 1 - 1 Goal! Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 1:1. He was ably assisted there by Linton Maina.
54' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
53' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) was too forceful with his tackle and Matthias Jollenbeck interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Bochum are awarded the free kick.
52' Takuma Asano (Bochum) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way past the left-hand post.
50' Takuma Asano (Bochum) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Marvin Schwabe.
49' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bochum was in an offside position.
47' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
45+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bochum, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' A pass lands at the feet of Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
42' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
40' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) has tested the patience of referee Matthias Jollenbeck and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
40' Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
37' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
35' Takuma Asano (Bochum) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him.
33' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
31' The foul by Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) was seen by Matthias Jollenbeck who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
29' Bochum will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
27' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
25' 1 - 0 Goal! Lukas Daschner (Bochum) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:0.
25' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
23' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
23' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

22' A loose ball is pounced on by Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe is alert and makes a comfortable save.
21' A player from FC Koln commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
20' Great chance! Lukas Daschner (Bochum) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
19' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
17' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.

15' Manuel Riemann pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
15' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

14' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
12' Matthias Jollenbeck couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) and blew his whistle.
11' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
9' A decent cross gives Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
8' Excellent touch by Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
7' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
6' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
5' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) commits a rough foul. Matthias Jollenbeck stops the game and makes a call.
2' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
2' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) gets inside the box and tries to beat Marvin Schwabe with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
FC Koln will kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
